notes.title: DreadHaunt Hotfix 1.0.0.33
notes.notes:
Greetings Agents,

We’ve just released a hotfix to address issue that was preventing players from receiving XP in DreadHaunt Solo/Co-op Mode and other bugs. It contains:

[list]
[*] Bug fix that previously prevents player not gaining XP on Co-Op/Solo Mode
[*] Fixed Mamat/Agent Betjeng mesh messing with first person camera
[*] Fixed Assault Mode UI HUD state indicator showing different text on client
[*] Added several names to Credits
[/list]

This update now allows you to continue your haunting and gain rewards for your hard work! We also humbly apologize for the inconvenience caused by this particular bug.

Thank you so much for your patience and support for DreadHaunt!

:DH

notes.title: ⚠︎ Major FREE Update ASSAULT MODE Now Live! ⚠︎
notes.notes:
[h1]Pack it in, Agents! You've just promoted to an Assault Team![/h1]

[h2]Secure The Perimeter! Spectromorphs containment is now top priority![/h2]

The fight against the s̴̜͇̖͉̎p̷̯̲͙̿̿̎e̴͎̠͐̊̅̑c̷̢̺̭̈́͊͒t̵̤̞͎̞̑̔r̶͈͛̌o̸͍̽͜m̴̛̳̠̆o̵̤͚͓̱͘r̴̲̭̿p̵̨̠̦̽̓͗̕ḩ̴̨̨̛̳̬͋̄͛̎s̴͎̓ just got more intense. Assault Mode introduces a high-stakes [b]first-person survival[/b] mode where you and your squad must hold the line against relentless waves of spectral containment fractured.

[previewyoutube=czxX6Is6fB0;full][trailer embed][/previewyoutube]

[h2]A New Special Agent Enters the Battlefield![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/06fb10ac772fbe06480747dded7c65d2c45b5c04.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/33ca27862f57b35d3667bb102e1e74e7a8c93136.png[/img]

Reinforcements have arrived! A [b]brand-new, FREE playable Assault Special Agent[/b] is joining the ranks, trained to handle the most extreme containment scenarios. With specialized abilities and combat expertise, they’re ready to push back the rising chaos. Will you lead them to victory?

[h2]Gear Up with FREE Assault Mode Costumes![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/e7fdbdfc3bfed58a0dc0c7b8136b3639f149e3ea.png[/img]

Prepare for high-intensity combat! [b]Every agent is receiving a FREE Assault Mode costume[/b] to match the escalating threat. These battle-ready outfits are designed for durability, mobility, and, of course, style. Suit up and take the fight to the anomalies!

[h2]Get DreadHaunt Now![/h2]
DreadHaunt is available on PC via Steam and Xbox for $19.99, with a limited-time 30% discount during the Assault Mode launch week!

Lock & Load, agents. The survival begins NOW!

notes.title: Jingle All the Way to The Latest Christmas Update
notes.notes:
We're having a holiday vibe at the HQ, Agents! And new intel suggests that Santa has already delivered the early Christmas gifts! So here are the updates for this year's Holiday Season.

[h2]Unwrap the FREE Gift![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/ade6d8f7fa13f8c8ad959eab63d6e54354c0b6eb.png[/img]
We heard that the gift contains some holiday-themed costumes for all agents that are also categorized as [b]FREEBIES[/b]!

Don’t forget to unwrap it inside your locker, so you can cozily hunt down the anomalies, in the holiday vibes! 

[h2]Do You Like Sweets? Because Something Just Got Eye-Candier! [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/50c140e8c79ded331e699bcd017cd6a501efdbda.gif[/img]
It’s a fresh look and feel with the revamped UI! Making mode selections smoother and more intuitive. Also, it paves the way for an upcoming new game mode: Assault. 

With this UI update, we hope it will enhance your experience in playing DreadHaunt and we're always open for any feedback you think can improve DreadHaunt.


[h2] Not Just Candies. There are also Gnomes, Sleigh, And Trees![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/c60498fb6245957d3703580e30308f6a3c5cda58.gif[/img]
For unknown reasons, the environments of the Factory understands that the holiday season requires Christmas trees, gift boxes, and of course, gnomes! 

HQ also classified these changes as non-threatening and presumably even liven up your mission onward.

[h2]It’s Christmas, So Here’s Something More![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/cbea87f7904e7016e9de729cd45bae9eaccad304.gif[/img]
As you frantically hunt down them creatures with the agents, you will gain extra points. Yep, you heard it right, Prepare to revel in the joy of [b]DOUBLE XP[/b] during this [b]ENTIRE[/b] festive season!

[h2]Frosty Deal Awaits![/h2]
If you, or your friends-who-you-want-to-play-with, haven’t had DreadHaunt in your Steam library just yet, you can also wishlist it to get notified during the upcoming Steam Winter Sale!

Now that we’ve delivered the updates, we hope you all enjoy the gifts. Thank you so much for supporting DreadHaunt!

Happy Holidays!

:DH

P.S. Follow us and stay up to date on our social media as well to get the latest scoop of the news!

notes.title: SOLO / CO-OP MODE IS AVAILABLE! DreadHaunt Update 2024/03/25
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/35e732b3253e0f9989929fafe84c4eceeefbb3a4.png[/img]
Hello agents, 

Today we are releasing an exciting new mode. the Solo / Co-op Mode!!

Some time has passed since DreadHaunt’s last update. In this one, we would like to present you with a new experience in addition to the multiplayer modes. Where you can create and play a session [b]with or without[/b] teammates.

[h1]NEW MODE, THE FIRST-PERSON SOLO / CO-OP MODE[/h1]

- Embark with a fresh viewpoint.
- Exploit a new sets of tools the agency provides.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/6364f3598070c1a3ab52e2542463dbd5766fc662.png[/img]

[h2]- A WHOLE NEW MAP, THE ABANDONED VILLAGE[/h2]

- Explore the abandoned village, with its secrets, and supernatural risks.
- Uncover the burrowed tragedy, untouched for years until the Agency decides to send you.

[h2]- WIELD THE EQUIPMENTS, AND DIVE HEADSTRONG INTO YOUR MISSION[/h2]

- there are three types of important equipment you can wield to help your mission.
    - Handheld UV blaster.
    - Normal Headlight, and the Spectral Headlight.
    - Detector, to indicate the whereabouts of unseen ghosts with audiovisual cue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/47e08837b0bec262b602215f78c92ee7589fb45d.gif[/img]

[h2]- HEAD ON YOUR OWN, OR WITH OTHER AGENTS[/h2]

- play alone, utilizing the core tools by yourself.
- or with teammates, adding support roles to the journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/68eb424c4e81673e9a80ff85c444a752ef568bdf.gif[/img]

[h2]- FIND VARIOUS PARANORMAL EVIDENCE[/h2]

- Find the paranormal evidence to advance the mission progress.
- uncover enough, and maybe you will figure out what happened in this Haunting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/c4fb8a376fe1c790c47c6a4c927c1089842dc366.gif[/img]

[h2]- SHOOT THE EVER-PRESENT APPARITIONS WITH YOUR UV BLASTER[/h2]

- The apparitions are invisible to the naked eye.
- Keep watch of your Detector’s audiovisual cue.
- Utilize your Spectral Headlight to reveal them.
- Banish them with the UV Blaster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/4b6308da1d194998ea8271167fb7ce82dc4603b3.gif[/img]

[h2]- SURVIVE![/h2]

Let us know what you think of this new first-person mode. feedbacks are very welcome!

Join the [url=discord.gg/dreaduniverse]Official Dread Universe Discord[/url] to talk more in-depth and share your experiences. **You can also find other willing agents to play together in the #matchmaking channel.**

[h1]ADDITIONAL INFORMATION[/h1]

[h2]- Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h2]

As usual, We squashed some bugs and fine-tuned several aspects to ensure smooth gameplay. However, don’t hesitate to reach out if you have feedback and suggestions!

[h2]- Future Update Sneak Peek[/h2]

Based on the timeline that we shared, the single-player mode is in the works. We’re also working on the game economy like XP accumulation and cosmetics rewards.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1855580/extras/content_release_plan_fixed.jpg?t=1703069105[/img]

That is all for now. Thank you for your continued support for DreadHaunt!

Best regards :DH

 - Digital Happiness

notes.title: DreadHaunt Update 2023-12-20
notes.notes:
Good day, Agents.

We have updated DreadHaunt to version 20231218, and these are notable details that the HQ want to share:

[h2]Post-Session Results Screen[/h2]

After each session, you’ll be presented with an eye-catching post-result screen. Showing who’s the possessed one, who survived (or didn’t), and how many points you racked up during the mission. 

[h2](Ongoing) Audio Updates[/h2]

We decided to overhaul the Audio System including BGM & SFX assets. You will notice a few changes during gameplay

[h2](Ongoing) Controller Support[/h2]

Controller support is available in very early stage. If you the controller-wielding type of agent, we are looking forward to hear your experiences!

[h2]Bug Fixes, Here and There[/h2]

- Added subtitle size option to Settings.
- Spectro damage effect +15%
- Kunti attack charge 25 -> 28.75
- Asih attack charge 10 -> 11.5
- Prevent drop tools while opening voter
- BugFix: Kunti attack charge hit multiple times
- Add condition to disable host quit button when in game
- add descriptions to sprectro skills
- fix mouse cursor not reappearing during waiting for players

[h2]Known Bugs/Glitches[/h2]

- BGM not playing on Versus Mode
- etc.

[h2]Sneak Peek of Future Contents[/h2]

We have a Content Update Plans on the DreadHaunt store page, check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855580/DreadHaunt/

Last but not least, if you have any suggestions or experienced bugs or glitches about the game, Feel free to reach us out on Steam Community Forum and our official discord server at discord.gg/dreaduniverse

notes.title: Versus, Is a New Mode! - DreadHaunt Early Access Update 2023-11-21
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/c4eeadcd1eaa7c992126bc6eed88d743a8d26744.jpg[/img]
Hello agents,

Today we have updated DreadHaunt to version EA-20231121 which contains:

[h2]Versus Mode[/h2]
One major feature in this update is the introduction of [b]Versus Mode[/b], where the game will skip deception part and goes straight to PVP chaos along with adjustment to game rules & mechanism. Check it out yourself! (and if you bring friends, test your friendship)

This mode is still fresh from our oven so if you have any feedback, or experiencing any bugs/glitches, please don't hesitate to reach us out.

[h2]More Localization Options[/h2]
We're adding Russian, and Spanish into the language selections. Please be note that Localization is always [b]work in progress[/b] and some words may be not translated yet. 

[h2]Fixes, here and there[/h2]
We have squashed some bugs based on your reports and our internal testing. you can check the patch notes at:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1855580/discussions/0/3944650879128904931/
